research_method: Public primary documentation and limited public-page inspection via web tool; no pricing APIs or anti-bot workarounds. Generic retrieval errors have unknown HTTP cause.

sources.name: SteamDB historical prices
verified_facts: FAQ describes per-app price graphs; it disclaims completeness. Automated scraping is prohibited; academic scraping requires permission.
sources.steam_store_separation: Steam price graphs; purchase-option matching still needed
sources.access: Public UI; programmatic data access not authorized
sources.official_api_or_export: No usable public API verified; FAQ describes potential partner access, not a public endpoint
sources.reproducibility: Permissioned export would be needed for repeatable collection
sources.limitations: No app price pages scraped; no complete log established; independence from ITAD must be checked

sources.name: SteamDB sales/event history
verified_facts: A public event calendar was discoverable; the retrieved extract did not provide 2023–2025 app-level membership.
sources.timestamps: Event dates; no app observations retrieved
sources.limitations: Being absent from an event list would not establish absence of every Steam discount

sources.name: Steam store / IStoreService
verified_facts: Documented change markers describe store updates, not a publicly documented complete retrospective price log.
sources.timestamps: Modification metadata is not a historical price observation
sources.access: Store public; API-specific access requirements apply
sources.official_api_or_export: IStoreService documented; historical price export not verified
sources.automation_permission: Only documented methods subject to Valve terms; no store scraping used
sources.limitations: Current prices were not collected or used for historical outcomes

sources.name: Steam publisher news / ISteamNews
verified_facts: Public news retrieval is documented by AppID with enddate and count parameters. News is not continuous store-price coverage.
sources.steam_store_separation: Publisher announcements require explicit storefront, edition and time checks
sources.timestamps: News publication time; not necessarily time of a store-price observation
sources.temporary_discount_capture: Some announcements describe discounts; target-pair price evidence not retrieved
sources.completeness: News pagination and publisher posting do not guarantee price-change completeness
sources.access: Public community pages; documented public news method
sources.official_api_or_export: GetNewsForApp/v2 documented; not a pricing API
sources.rate_limits: Numerical news quota not verified in reviewed method page
sources.automation_permission: Public documented method; no permission for unrestricted store scraping inferred
sources.reproducibility: Exact attempted URLs recorded; extracted page contents can change
sources.limitations: 17 distinct app feeds opened; one documented API probe failed; no current-year outcomes retained

sources.name: Valve publisher financial reports
verified_facts: Publisher financial methods require an authorized financial API key. Transaction fields distinguish Steam/Retail and include country and pricing fields.
sources.individual_appids: Publisher-owned products/packages; not arbitrary public AppIDs
sources.timestamps: Daily accounting periods, not all offer changes
sources.official_api_or_export: Documented financial API, not a public price-history export
sources.automation_permission: Authorized publisher only; no requests made
sources.reproducibility: Credentials and authorized publisher records required
sources.limitations: No sales transactions do not establish no discount; complete offer schedules would need separate evidence

sources.name: Internet Archive / Wayback Machine
verified_facts: Availability API and CDX capture lookup are documented. A successful lookup identifies captures, not continuous coverage.
sources.individual_appids: Steam app URLs can be queried; pilot capture availability unverified
sources.steam_store_separation: Original store URL must match; bundles/resellers excluded
sources.timestamps: Capture timestamp; rendered price origin and freshness need checking
sources.temporary_discount_capture: Only if a capture contains the relevant price during the event
sources.completeness: Sampled web captures; missing resources and live fallbacks possible
sources.access: Public documented lookups; one CDX probe unavailable through research tool
sources.rate_limits: No numeric quota verified; do not infer unlimited access
sources.automation_permission: Documented lookup only; no restrictions bypassed
sources.reproducibility: Save original URL, capture URL/time and response hashes if obtained; none obtained
sources.limitations: Failed CDX retrieval is not an empty capture index; external archive component stopped

sources.name: Common Crawl
verified_facts: Public URL indexes and WARC downloads are documented; crawl collections exist for 2023–2025.
sources.individual_appids: URL-level potential; pilot captures not looked up
sources.steam_store_separation: Needs original Steam store URL and captured price payload
sources.completeness: Sampled crawls, not continuous offer monitoring
sources.access: Public downloads; Athena requires AWS account/cost
sources.official_api_or_export: Documented CDXJ/columnar indexes and WARC export
sources.rate_limits: CDX heavily rate limited; HTTPS, spaced single-thread requests, descriptive User-Agent; no proxies; numerical quota unspecified
sources.automation_permission: Documented download subject to terms and underlying content rights
sources.reproducibility: Capture metadata plus WARC offset/hash if retrieved
sources.limitations: No WARC or pilot capture retrieved; content rights are not automatically transferred

sources.name: Steambase
verified_facts: Public tracker exposes monthly Steam summaries, separately from key-marketplace offers. Disclaimer does not guarantee completeness.
sources.steam_store_separation: Steam monthly table separate from reseller section
sources.timestamps: Monthly aggregates; exact target-event points not retrieved
sources.access: Public UI; terms specify personal non-commercial access and consent for content reuse
sources.automation_permission: Bulk collection/republication permission not established; stopped before collection
sources.reproducibility: Month summaries do not locate discounts within a sale; chart payload not exported
sources.limitations: One selected 2023 game inspected; rendered monthly table did not reach target year; no historical price copied
